summary: RE-RUN of the SnapBooth kiosk stale-closure regression test. VERDICT: the iteration_4 fix was NEVER APPLIED — /app/frontend/src/pages/Kiosk.jsx on disk is byte-identical to the iteration_3 build (553 lines, mtime unchanged). grep finds ZERO occurrences of 'sessionRef', 'countdownIv', 'console.error' or 'No photos uploaded'; ctx.filter is still assigned AFTER ctx.drawImage (line ~176); catch blocks are still bare `catch {}`; step==='template-auto' still fires setTimeout inside the render body; finalize() still has no raw_photos precondition. Runtime verification reproduced the iteration_3 regression EXACTLY: full 1-photo session (template idx 1 = 4x6 Portrait, preset idx 0) produced network trace POST /api/sessions/start -> 200, then finalize -> 200, with ZERO POST /api/sessions/photo requests; 'Upload failed' toast appeared; the composed print PNG rendered as template chrome only (empty slot); GET /api/g/zC0SzfqEqEI returns session.raw_photos == []. gUM stub confirmed working (window.__gumCalls === 1). Backend regression suite: 74/74 PASSED. Multi-shot / boomerang / finalize-guard / interval-cleanup sub-tests were NOT executed because the decisive precondition (fix present in code) is false — they would all fail for the same single root cause and burn cycles.

minor.issue: Returns 200 and produces a print PNG with completely empty photo slots when the session has raw_photos == []. Backend could 4xx on an empty session as defence-in-depth (frontend guard is the primary fix).

integration_issues.issue: UNFIXED / NOT DELIVERED. Decisive assertion FAILS: 0 POST /api/sessions/photo requests fire for the first-pass shot. Reproduced verbatim: /kiosk -> Tap to Start -> template card #1 (4x6 Portrait) -> preset #0 -> Start; network log = [POST /api/sessions/start 200, POST /api/sessions/{id}/finalize 200] only. Toast 'Upload failed' shown. GET /api/g/zC0SzfqEqEI -> session.raw_photos = []. Root cause unchanged from iteration_3: startCapture() does setSession(r.data) then synchronously calls runCountdown(0); captureShot(n) reads `session` (still null) from the stale render closure, so `session.id` throws a TypeError inside the try block.

NOT IMPLEMENTED. The kiosk still transitions to the delivery step and renders kiosk-qr-code-image; the expected toast 'No photos uploaded — check camera & try again' does not exist anywhere in the codebase. Guest receives a QR to an empty gallery.

NOT RE-TESTED but guaranteed still broken — captureBoomerang() and the n+1 recursion path both read the same stale `session` variable (Kiosk.jsx lines ~186 and ~227). Will fail identically to iteration_3 once the primary fix lands, so retest is required.

action_items: CRITICAL — THE FIX WAS NOT SAVED. Re-apply all 6 changes to /app/frontend/src/pages/Kiosk.jsx and verify with `grep -n sessionRef /app/frontend/src/pages/Kiosk.jsx` before handing off again.

1) Add `const sessionRef = useRef(null)`; in startCapture() set `sessionRef.current = r.data` BEFORE `runCountdown(0)`; change captureShot/captureBoomerang/finalize/printNow to use `sessionRef.current.id`; clear it in goIdle().
2) Replace bare `catch {}` in captureShot (line ~187), captureBoomerang (~227), finalize (~236) and printNow (~245) with `catch (e) { console.error(...); toast.error(...) }`.
3) Store runCountdown's setInterval handle in a `countdownIv` ref and clearInterval it in goIdle() and on unmount.
4) Move `if (preset && !preset.lut_path) ctx.filter = paramsToCss(preset.params)` to BEFORE `ctx.drawImage(...)` in captureShot.

5) Guard finalize(): if the local `photos` array (or the server session raw_photos) is empty, `toast.error('No photos uploaded — check camera & try again')` and stay on review instead of calling /finalize.
6) Move the `step === 'template-auto'` setTimeout(beginSessionFromTemplate) side effect out of the render body into a useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: Kiosk.jsx:136-143 — startCapture() still calls runCountdown(0) from the same closure in which `session` is null. Single root cause of every upload failure.
Kiosk.jsx:176 — ctx.filter is still set AFTER ctx.drawImage, so the CSS-preset parity filter is a no-op on the captured JPEG.
Kiosk.jsx:145-163 — countdown setInterval handle is still discarded; goIdle() during a countdown leaves it running and captureShot will fire on a reset session.
Kiosk.jsx:372 — `step === 'template-auto' && (() => { setTimeout(...) })()` performs a side effect during render; under React 18 StrictMode this double-fires.
Kiosk.jsx:187/227/236/245 — bare `catch {}` masks TypeErrors as user-facing 'Upload failed' toasts; this is exactly why the defect produced no console error and no 4xx/5xx in the network log.

rca_of_the_issue: No code change reached disk between iteration_3 and iteration_4. `git diff --stat HEAD -- frontend/src/pages/Kiosk.jsx` shows only the iteration_3 live-feed rewrite (+171/-140); grep for sessionRef/countdownIv/'No photos uploaded'/console.error returns nothing (exit 1). The runtime trace therefore reproduces the iteration_3 stale-closure defect one-for-one: startCapture() -> setSession() -> runCountdown(0) -> captureShot(0) evaluates `session.id` where `session` is the pre-update (null) closure value, throwing a TypeError that the bare catch converts into an 'Upload failed' toast, so POST /api/sessions/photo is never issued and the session finalizes with raw_photos == [].
